item.title: Sea of Tranquillity
item.description:
I recently finished “Sea of Tranquillity” by Emily St. John Mandel and here are some thoughts about it.

The Book in 3 Sentences

  1. Time Travel with anomalies
  2. Temporal investigation and protocol breaking
  3. Reflect on the whole human experience

Impressions

I’ve skipped “The Glass Hotel” which (as far as I understood), is part of the same macro-universe. Some say that this book has been “lifechanging”, but I don’t complitely agree.

In general, I think this is a very interesting book, very easy and comfortable to read (I read 40-50 pages in block each session), and the story is interesting. The main problem is that I guessed the ending by half the book :(, so I ruined the surprise for myself.

item.title: Quit Social Media
item.description:
Some Notes from “Quit Social Media” by Dr. Cal Newport @ TedxTyson

Cal is not on social media.

He claims that he’s been more successful than ever without social media. My goal is to investigate why.

Debunking Common Objections

1. Social Media is one of the most important technologies in the 21st century. Rejecting it would be an act of extreme Luddism.

That’s pure nonsense. It is not a fundamental technology, but they leverage off a fundamental technology (think of it as slot machines). It’s pure (unsavoury) entertainment, and nothing more.
